```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)
```

```{r load}
library(R3DFEM)
```

The 3D-CMCC-FEM needs a set of .txt files, all in the same directory and named after the
site (`Site`) or the species. This vignette describes them and the helpers that create
them. All the helpers write the file in `outdir` and return the data invisibly;
`setup_inputs()` calls them in one go (see `vignette("R3DFEM")`).

| File | Content | Helpers |
|---|---|---|
| `Site_stand.txt` | initial stand: species, age, number of trees, DBH, height per class | `make_stand()`, `virtual_stand_generator()` |
| `Site_meteo.txt` | daily weather | `make_meteo()`, `make_meteo_EOBS()`, `make_CCS()`, `check_meteo_3DFEM()` |
| `Site_co2.txt` | yearly atmospheric CO2 concentration | `make_co2()`, `make_CCS()` |
| `Site_soil.txt` | soil texture and depth | `make_soil()`, `make_soil_ISRIC()` |
| `Site_topo.txt` | elevation | `make_topo()` |
| `Site_management.txt` | management events (only with `man = "var"`) | `make_management()` |
| `Species.txt` | species parameterization (version 5.7) | `list_species()`, `copy_species()`, `read_species()`, `set_species_param()` |

```{r dir}
inputdir <- file.path(tempdir(), "Collelongo")
```

## Stand

One row per class (species, age, DBH, height) and year. With `man = "var"` and
`pres_dens = "on"` the rows of the following years prescribe the stand density.

```{r stand}
make_stand("Collelongo", year = 2000, age = c(90, 120), species = "Fagussylvatica",
           n_trees = c(600, 150), avdbh = c(28, 45), height = c(22, 27), outdir = inputdir)
```

## Meteo

Daily data with the columns Year, Month, n_days, Rg_f (MJ m^-2^ day^-1^), Ta_f, Tmax,
Tmin (°C), RH_f (%), Ts_f, Precip (mm day^-1^), SWC, LAI, ET and WS_f (-9999 when not
available). `make_meteo()` converts any daily data.frame (e.g. a weather station): it
computes the mean temperature if missing, converts the radiation from W m^-2^
(`rad_unit = "W"`) and checks the result with `check_meteo_3DFEM()`.

```{r meteo}
soro <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "soro", "Soroe_meteo.txt", package = "R3DFEM"))
station <- data.frame(date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-%02d", soro$Year, soro$Month, soro$n_days)),
                      Rg_f = soro$Rg_f / 0.0864, Tmax = soro$Tmax, Tmin = soro$Tmin,
                      Precip = soro$Precip, RH_f = soro$RH_f)
station <- subset(station, date < as.Date("2031-01-01"))
head(station, 3)
meteo <- make_meteo(station, "Collelongo", rad_unit = "W", outdir = inputdir)
```

```{r plot-meteo, fig.height = 5}
plot_meteo_3DFEM(file.path(inputdir, "Collelongo_meteo.txt"), var = c("Tmax", "Tmin", "Precip"),
                 daterange = c("2000-01-01", "2002-12-31"), window = 30)
```

For European sites the weather can be extracted from
[E-OBS](https://surfobs.climate.copernicus.eu/dataaccess/access_eobs.php) (version 30.0 or
29.0). The netCDF files (ensemble mean, 0.1 degrees, variables hu, qq, rr, tg, tn, tx) are
not distributed with the package: download them and set their directory once.

```{r eobs, eval = FALSE}
options(R3DFEM.eobs_dir = "D:/EOBS")
make_meteo_EOBS(data.frame(x = 13.59, y = 41.85), crs = 4326, site = "Collelongo",
                daterange = c("2000-01-01", "2023-12-31"), outdir = inputdir)
```

`make_CCS()` builds a detrended "current climate scenario" by resampling the observed
years (leap years with leap years), e.g. to run the model beyond the observations:

```{r ccs}
make_CCS(meteo = file.path(inputdir, "Collelongo_meteo.txt"), obs_year = c(2000, 2020),
         end_year = 2100, outdir = file.path(tempdir(), "ccs"))
```

## CO2

Yearly concentration (ppm). `make_co2()` accepts a constant, one value per year or known
values interpolated linearly over the years:

```{r co2}
co2 <- make_co2("Collelongo", years = 2000:2100,
                co2 = data.frame(year = c(2000, 2020, 2100), CO2_ppm = c(369, 412, 600)),
                outdir = inputdir)
co2[c(1, 21, 101), ]
```

## Soil and topography

```{r soil}
make_soil("Collelongo", lat = 41.85, lon = 13.59, clay = 25, silt = 35, sand = 40,
          soil_depth = 100, outdir = inputdir)
make_topo("Collelongo", elev = 1560, outdir = inputdir)
```

```{r plot-soil, fig.height = 5}
plot_soil_3DFEM(file.path(inputdir, "Collelongo_soil.txt"), pch = 21, bg.symbols = "red", cex = 2)
```

The texture of European sites can be taken from SoilGrids (raster not distributed with the
package):

```{r isric, eval = FALSE}
options(R3DFEM.isric_file = "D:/SoilGrids/ISRIC.tif")
make_soil_ISRIC(data.frame(x = 13.59, y = 41.85), crs = 4326, site = "Collelongo",
                outdir = inputdir)
```

## Management

Used with `man = "var"`: years of thinning (and their intensity, % of basal area),
harvesting and regeneration.

```{r management}
make_management("Collelongo", thinning = c(2010, 2030), thinning_int = c(25, 20),
                harvesting = 2060, outdir = inputdir)
readLines(file.path(inputdir, "Collelongo_management.txt"))
```

With `man = "on"` the model manages the stand with the parameters ROTATION, THINNING and
THINNING_INTENSITY of the species file instead.

## Species parameters

The package contains the parameterizations of the version 5.7 of the model. Coppice
stands have their own files (e.g. `Fagussylvatica_coppice`).

```{r species}
list_species()
copy_species("Fagussylvatica", inputdir)
sp <- read_species(file.path(inputdir, "Fagussylvatica.txt"))
nrow(sp)
head(sp)
```

`set_species_param()` changes one or more parameters, keeping the comments and the order of
the file, and returns the previous values (with `outfile` it writes a new file, e.g. a
site-specific parameterization):

```{r set-param}
set_species_param(file.path(inputdir, "Fagussylvatica.txt"), LIGHT_TOL = 2, ROTATION = 140)
```

The version 5.7 needs all the parameters of these files, including `CONV_VOL_FACTOR`
(conversion of stem biomass to volume). Files of older versions are refused by
`check_inputs()` and `run_3DCMCCFEM()`:

```{r old-file, error = TRUE}
old <- file.path(tempdir(), "old")
dir.create(old)
file.copy(list.files(inputdir, full.names = TRUE), old)
sp_lines <- readLines(file.path(old, "Fagussylvatica.txt"))
writeLines(sp_lines[!grepl("^CONV_VOL_FACTOR", sp_lines)], file.path(old, "Fagussylvatica.txt"))
check_inputs("Collelongo", "Fagussylvatica", 2000, 2030, man = "off", inputdir = old)
```

## Checking the inputs

```{r check}
check_inputs("Collelongo", "Fagussylvatica", year_start = 2000, year_end = 2030,
             man = "var", pres_dens = "off", inputdir = inputdir,
             rep_species = "Fagussylvatica", rep_trees = 3000, rep_age = 3, rep_dbh = 1,
             rep_lai = 1, rep_height = 1.3)
list.files(inputdir)
```

For all details on the input files see the model
[User Guide](http://eprints.bice.rm.cnr.it/22393/1/3D-CMCC-FEM_User_Guide_v.2_July_2023.pdf).
